title: Make standard s-ts-no-floating-promises pass
body: Outcome: `krn standards check --record s-ts-no-floating-promises` no longer fails s-ts-no-floating-promises.

Why: adoption found this reflex standard failing: exit 1 from node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const read=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const biome=["biome.json","biome.jsonc"].map(read).joi...
Files: the files the failing check names (run the Proof command).
